outer.label: EJ
outer.selectionReason: EJ keeps EI's verified front but materially rebuilds the weak back cover: the main travel-memory photograph becomes a 793.7x760 full-bleed field; two support photographs overlap it at unequal scales and rotations; the Japanese back-cover headline is enlarged in solid white; the lower region is reduced to one cream editorial field containing a compact three-column by two-row travel log. Redundant FRIENDS micro-labels were subtracted. This is more photo-led and print-native than EI without adding UI cards, rounded rectangles, gradients, or synthetic effects.
rejectedIntermediates: Initial EJ back-cover actual-size render placed the second travel-log row too close to the inherited footer, causing visual clipping/collision. The row and footer were recomposed and re-rendered before promotion.
Two nested decorative FRIENDS 01 / FRIENDS 02 micro-labels survived the first subtraction pass and were removed after actual-size review.
